from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class HousingStart(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point for single-family housing starts extracted from one report."""
    observation_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, e.g., '2022-08'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The number of housing starts reported for the month")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the source report, used to resolve conflicts")
    units: str | None = Field(description="The unit of measurement, e.g., 'thousands'")
    adjustment_type: Literal["not seasonally adjusted"] | None = Field(description="The seasonal adjustment status specified in the task")
    housing_category: Literal["single-family"] | None = Field(description="The housing type specified in the task")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_starts: list[HousingStart]
